headline: Expanse Boils as Shelf and Nevish Lines Quicken
war_summary: Since the afternoon edition the tempo has quickened in the north and centre while older sectors have gone quiet. The Weathered Expanse now lists 39 changes in twenty-four hours, nine in the last two, with holdings standing one Warden, seven Colonial and one unheld around Crow's Nest, Wightwalk and Huntsfort, and day losses near 12,300 Colonial and 18,200 Warden. Stlican Shelf has risen to 28 changes, six in two hours, holdings two Warden, six Colonial and one unheld about Fort Hoarfrost and Breaker Town. The Nevish Line counts 20 changes, six in two hours, holdings six Warden to two Colonial about Blackcoat Way, Blinding Stones and Grief Mother. Palantine Berm stirs again with 12 changes, one in two hours, still seven Warden-held, while Kuura Strand shows four changes in two hours about Talven with one post unheld. Callahan's Passage eases to seven changes with none in six hours at eight Warden to two Colonial, and Stonecradle and Linn Mercy report 12 and five changes respectively with nothing in six hours.
